text_block_list.text:
"Summer training camp ends tomorrow.
Because of that, I wanted to push it to the absolute limit today, but..."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...That's all for now, right?
choice_data_list: Ah, let's save the rest for after sunset.
Yeah, let's do the rest after the sun goes down.

text_block_list.text:
Today was an intensely hot day, surpassing the temperatures of the days before.
Putting any more strain on her body would do more harm than good.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I know that!
Rome wasn't built in a day!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You can't just get strong out of nowhere!
I'll be sure to work hard on my special training,
step by steady step!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Besides, there are still things we can do! Like coming up with tactical plans—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah――!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *phew*...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Ai-chan.
You're not sweating at all...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Impressive. You're fine even in this heat?
And you're going for another run...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Her physical abilities are top-tier too...!
And she handles the heat like a champ...!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...We're rivals!
The ultimate rivals, in fact!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: We can't afford to lose either!

"And so, Kiseki and I
observed Almond Eye's training
for a little while."
—That night.

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, everyone!
It's lights-out already~!
Get back to your rooms!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay!
...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Kiseki-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...? Ai-chan?
If you're going back to the training camp lodge,
it's that way, not this way.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: It's fine this way. More importantly—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You were watching, weren't you?
My training session, that is.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: How was it? What did you feel?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Well, of course~...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I was just thinking you look really strong~.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ~~gh, that's right! Fufufu!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I went to watch your Kikuka Sho too.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
My heart was pounding, down to the tip of my tail.
I couldn't take my eyes off it.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: You know—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I want to win.
In the Triple Tiara as well.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Even in a race with you.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Huh...? 
This feeling... I've felt it before—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —I'd like you to teach me.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Almond-chan.
Could you perhaps be...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (Ever since I was in the Classic class and you were in the Junior class—?)
(Prick...)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...N-No, nothing!
It's totally nothing!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If the day comes when we face off,
I definitely won't lose to you!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the feeling is mutual.
Well then, good night!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah, good night!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Good night.

And with summer over,
the Umamusume move forward into autumn—
